threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the weekend's meant for sleeping in. Locals have their best nights out on a Monday at The Alibi.
Last night the N35 was packed with party-goers, but the lad in the corner was just muttering about his cat's diet. Strange what unfolds at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The night I heard an impromptu reggae jam on the street, while someone sold homemade samosas out of their kitchen window. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night kebab shop where the owner critiques your life choices while grilling your meat. It’s a whole vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows to avoid the BART Civic Center station when the fog rolls in—smoke and chaos are just part of the commute.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a busker belting out tunes. Half the riders were humming along, transforming the usual grind into a makeshift concert.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the bars close early, but if you wander a bit past 2 AM, you’ll find hidden gems still buzzing with life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their struggle to pronounce 'Gràcia' correctly while still fumbling with the metro card at Liceu station.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you’re new when you still expect the Overground to run on time. Locals just shrug and check their phones for cider pop-up events instead.
Caught the 35 past Brixton Market, saw a guy doing a magic trick with a pack of cards. The bus was packed, but everyone suddenly wanted to watch.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a man in full lederhosen juggling beers outside a Kebab shop on Hermannstraße, I knew Neukölln had me hooked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you catch trams holding spontaneous parties, complete with DJs and dance-offs, right in the middle of your commute.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid 16th Street BART during delays. The rest are still standing there confused when the smoke rises.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy take a nap on the 31 Balboa while his burrito fell out of his lap. SFFD came by to pick it up, but he slept through it all.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but the locals flock to the tiny bars with no signage for the best vermut in town.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the lack of pedestrian crossings on Carrer de Casanova, while still trying to find a shortcut.
